title: Echo Point
hook: The canyon overlook had one rule, rusted onto the railing: never shout your own name.
lines: On a road trip out west, we stopped at a canyon overlook called Echo Point.
A rusted sign on the railing had one rule. Never shout your own name.
My little brother Danny laughed, cupped his hands... and yelled his name as loud as he could.
The canyon threw it back. Danny... Danny... Danny...
Then it just kept going. Long after any echo should have stopped.
That night, at a motel off the highway, I woke up to a whisper outside our door.
Mom and Dad didn't stir. Danny was asleep in the bed next to mine.
The whisper slid closer... right up to the crack under the door.
And then, in the dark... Danny sat up and answered. I'm here.
In the morning, he seemed fine. Just quiet. Smiling a little too much.
But today at breakfast, he leaned across the table and asked me...
